text:
Type: round hanging wall shelf
Use: displaying small decor, plants or books; on a wall in a living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: rustic, farmhouse, bohemian
Materials: whitewashed fir veneer, dark metal hanging finial
Colors: light warm natural wood, whitewash, dark bronze
Shape: large circular hoop frame, two straight inner shelves, wood crown block with ornate metal hanger on top, open and airy, statement size
Feel: charming, relaxed, rustic
Goes with: white walls, natural wood, greenery, black metal; farmhouse or bohemian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Rustic Round Wood 2-Tier Shelf Floating Hanging Wall Unit- 30 Inch, Whitewashed Fir Veneer
product.description: Add a vintage flair to your walls with this rustic shelving unit. The fir veneer subtly peers through the whitewash, and the 2 shelves offer ample storage. Mount this unit to your wall via the elegant iron hook at the top. 30.12"H x 23.62"W x 4.92"D 85% medium-density fibreboard with fir veneer; 15% fir Shelf unit Avoid moisture. This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware is included.
